# Marjan Travel & Tours

> Marjan Travel & Tours is a licensed travel company in Bahria Town, Lahore, Pakistan, offering Umrah packages, international tour packages, visa consultancy and processing, corporate tours and domestic tour packages across Pakistan. Tagline: "Dream it. Book it. Live it."

Key facts:
- In business: more than 6 years; 5,500+ travellers, 2,200+ pilgrims, 1,500+ visa applications
- Address: Shop No. 25, First Floor, Metro Heights, Talwar Chowk, Bahria Town, Lahore, Pakistan
- Phone and WhatsApp: +92 303 8244423 | Email: info@marjantravels.com
- Office hours: 7 days a week, 9am to 9pm
- Status: licensed travel company
- Languages: Urdu, English

## Services
- [All services](https://marjantravels.com/services/): the five services, air tickets, hotel booking and travel insurance, and which service fits which trip.
- [Umrah Packages](https://marjantravels.com/services/umrah-packages/): 7, 10, 14, 15, 21 and 28-day Umrah packages from Pakistan with Umrah visa, return flights, hotels in Makkah and Madinah, and transport; economy to 5-star, family, group and Ramadan packages.
- [International Tour Packages](https://marjantravels.com/services/international-tour-packages/): Dubai, Baku (Azerbaijan), Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, Bali (Indonesia), Sri Lanka, Turkey, the Maldives, Georgia and Europe, with visa, flights, hotels, transfers and tours.
- [Visa Consultancy & Processing](https://marjantravels.com/services/visa-consultancy/): visit, family, business and Umrah visas for Pakistani passport holders, including UAE (Dubai), Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Azerbaijan, Thailand and Malaysia, and UK, Schengen, USA and Canada visa files.
- [Corporate Tour Packages](https://marjantravels.com/services/corporate-tour-packages/): company trips, team building, incentive travel, conferences, dealer trips, group Umrah for employees and business travel.
- [Domestic Tour Packages](https://marjantravels.com/services/pakistan-tour-packages/): guided tours to Hunza, Skardu, Swat, Naran Kaghan, Fairy Meadows, Murree, Neelum Valley and Kashmir, by road or by air.

- [About Us](https://marjantravels.com/about-us/): our story, the meaning of the name, mission, vision and values.
